title: Human development: the first trimester
description: Explore 35 developmental stages from a blastocyst to the end of the first trimester, using a consistent viewing direction.

frames.label: Day 5
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 5: A blastocyst contains an inner cell group and a fluid-filled cavity inside a thin outer shell.
frames.caption: A blastocyst contains an inner cell group and a fluid-filled cavity inside a thin outer shell.

frames.label: Day 6
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 6: The blastocyst begins to emerge from its shell.
frames.caption: The blastocyst begins to emerge from its shell.

frames.label: Day 7
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 7: The hatched blastocyst makes contact with the uterine lining.
frames.caption: The hatched blastocyst makes contact with the uterine lining.

frames.label: Day 8
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 8: Implantation begins as the surrounding tissue envelops the blastocyst.
frames.caption: Implantation begins as the surrounding tissue envelops the blastocyst.

frames.label: Day 9
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 9: The conceptus is embedded within the lining as the surface closes.
frames.caption: The conceptus is embedded within the lining as the surface closes.

frames.label: Day 10
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 10: Early fluid spaces surround a small embryonic cell group beneath the sealed surface.
frames.caption: Early fluid spaces surround a small embryonic cell group beneath the sealed surface.

frames.label: Day 11
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 11: Small blood-filled spaces develop in the surrounding implantation tissue.
frames.caption: Small blood-filled spaces develop in the surrounding implantation tissue.

frames.label: Day 12
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 12: A larger surrounding cavity opens around the early embryonic structures.
frames.caption: A larger surrounding cavity opens around the early embryonic structures.

frames.label: Day 13
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 13: Short projections develop around the outer sac; these are early chorionic villi.
frames.caption: Short projections develop around the outer sac; these are early chorionic villi.

frames.label: Day 14
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 14: A small embryonic disc lies between the amniotic and yolk-sac spaces.
frames.caption: A small embryonic disc lies between the amniotic and yolk-sac spaces.

frames.label: Day 15
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 15: The primitive streak begins to organise the cellular disc.
frames.caption: The primitive streak begins to organise the cellular disc.

frames.label: Day 16
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 16: The primitive streak and node help establish the developing body axis.
frames.caption: The primitive streak and node help establish the developing body axis.

frames.label: Day 17
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 17: The embryonic disc elongates as the early body layers become organised.
frames.caption: The embryonic disc elongates as the early body layers become organised.

frames.label: Day 18
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 18: The early neural plate begins to take shape.
frames.caption: The early neural plate begins to take shape.

frames.label: Day 19
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 19: Neural folds rise around a central groove as the head end begins to bend.
frames.caption: Neural folds rise around a central groove as the head end begins to bend.

frames.label: Day 20
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 20: A small head fold and early body segments become more apparent.
frames.caption: A small head fold and early body segments become more apparent.

frames.label: Day 21
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 21: Early neural folds, body segments and a cardiac prominence are visible.
frames.caption: Early neural folds, body segments and a cardiac prominence are visible.

frames.label: Day 24
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 24: The body curves further as neural development progresses.
frames.caption: The body curves further as neural development progresses.

frames.label: Day 28
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 28: A C-shaped embryo has a prominent head end and small limb buds.
frames.caption: A C-shaped embryo has a prominent head end and small limb buds.

frames.label: Day 31
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 31: The limb buds lengthen while the head remains proportionally large.
frames.caption: The limb buds lengthen while the head remains proportionally large.

frames.label: Day 35
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 35: The head grows and the arm tips broaden toward hand plates.
frames.caption: The head grows and the arm tips broaden toward hand plates.

frames.label: Day 38
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 38: Paddle-shaped hand plates become clearer as the limbs lengthen.
frames.caption: Paddle-shaped hand plates become clearer as the limbs lengthen.

frames.label: Day 42
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 42: The hands and feet remain broad plates as their internal pattern develops.
frames.caption: The hands and feet remain broad plates as their internal pattern develops.

frames.label: Day 45
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 45: Notches and finger rays begin to separate the developing digits.
frames.caption: Notches and finger rays begin to separate the developing digits.

frames.label: Day 49
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 49: The limbs bend and the outlines of the digits become more distinct.
frames.caption: The limbs bend and the outlines of the digits become more distinct.

frames.label: Day 52
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 52: The developing hands, feet and facial profile are increasingly recognisable.
frames.caption: The developing hands, feet and facial profile are increasingly recognisable.

frames.label: Day 56
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 56: Small hands and feet are clearer and the earlier tail-like outline has regressed.
frames.caption: Small hands and feet are clearer and the earlier tail-like outline has regressed.

frames.label: Day 59
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 59: The limbs become more slender while the head remains large.
frames.caption: The limbs become more slender while the head remains large.

frames.label: Day 63
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 63: Separated digits and a developing facial profile are visible.
frames.caption: Separated digits and a developing facial profile are visible.

frames.label: Day 66
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 66: The eyelids are closed and the limbs are more defined.
frames.caption: The eyelids are closed and the limbs are more defined.

frames.label: Day 70
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 70: A clearer profile, hands and feet accompany a longer trunk.
frames.caption: A clearer profile, hands and feet accompany a longer trunk.

frames.label: Day 73
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 73: The trunk and limbs lengthen gradually.
frames.caption: The trunk and limbs lengthen gradually.

frames.label: Day 77
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 77: The body remains slender and curled, with a proportionally large head.
frames.caption: The body remains slender and curled, with a proportionally large head.

frames.label: Day 80
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 80: The limbs and facial profile continue to become more defined.
frames.caption: The limbs and facial profile continue to become more defined.

frames.label: Day 83
frames.alt: Illustrative prenatal development, day 83: The first-trimester endpoint shows a small fetus with closed eyelids and delicate limbs.
frames.caption: The first-trimester endpoint shows a small fetus with closed eyelids and delicate limbs.

note: AI-generated educational reconstructions using a transparent viewing window; not clinical images. Stages and timing are approximate. Viewing direction is consistent; magnification varies and images are not to scale.
